actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident contributed >30 in the last round, and my wallet (4.92) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I cannot contribute the minimum 1 unit. I rest and broadcast a reminder against large contributions.
